title: Slovakian Pork Dumplings with Airy Dumpling Dough
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring tender pork and airy dumpling dough. Perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: dumpling dough slovakian
ingredients.notes: available in some European markets or online

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, warm water, salt, and 1 tablespoon of oil. Mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll into balls.
On a floured surface, roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of pork mixture in center of each dough circle.
Fold dough over filling and press edges to seal.
In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Drain dumplings and serve hot with melted butter and chopped fresh parsley.
